settings.headline: Pay a bill
settings.subtitle: Every way to pay in the story district, what happens if you are late, and what to do if a bill looks wrong. This demo collects no payment and no account number.

settings.headline: Ways to pay (story)
settings.body:
By card or bank draft through the customer portal link on a real district site — here, that button would go to the district's payment provider. This fictional site deliberately has no payment form.

By phone, mail, or in person at 1 Reservoir Lane, Mon–Fri 8–5 (story hours). Drop box by the front door for checks after hours.

Auto-draft on the 15th, with a paper bill still mailed unless you opt out.
settings.side:
Check the read dates first — a 45-day read after a meter swap is the most common story cause. Then compare last year, not last month: summer watering doubles many Carrow Bend bills.

Still off? Request a re-read before the due date; late fees pause while a re-read is open (story policy).

settings.headline: Fees around billing
settings.intro: Plain amounts, published before you need them.

items.b: 5% after 10 days past due, story policy
Free if the read was wrong; fee if it was right
